--- Page 7 --- AGANCHENGANI A'chik bi'sarangna bang'a ki'taprangko sena nangkuenga.
Da'o je ki'taprangko jakkalengachim, uarangoni bang'batan an'chingna ka'sagipa Missionaryrangni see donanggiparang aro pagit- chamrangni seanggiparangsan ong'a.
Achikkuchi poraina gita text bookko IDr.
Miles Bronson 1867-68 bilsirango sechengaha.
Ua chasong- oni a'bachenge da'o adita king kitaprang chon- chongipa classrango poraigiparangna ong kataha.
Indiba chasongni kri.
gital gital ki'taprangko bi'sarangna nanga, jedakode uamang chasongni kri uidapanirangko man'gen.
Uandake bang'a ki-taprangkon A chik bi'sarangna nangengkua.
Chengonin Class V aro Class VI -o poraigipa A chik bi'sarang Garo subject-o Class IV na tarigipa ki'tapkosa poraitokenga.
Da'alonaba iana text book tarigipa darangba dongkuja.
Iandake angni ka'sara A chik bi'sarangna nanganiko nike anga ia chongipa kitap kingsako tariaha.
Man'adipet Class V aro Class VI ni gadangna krae iako tarina jotton ka'aha, uamangni uina nanganirangko on'gen.

--- Page 8 --- Ia ki'tapo Meghalaya A'songni jatrangni dakbe- walrang, jakgitelanina krenggiparang, cholon- bewalko rikanina dakchakani ong'nakgipa seani- rang, jatko dilgiparangni kamrang, bolrangna ka'sana skianirang, mande mandeska baksa meli-nangrime janggi tanganirang aro uandake seanirangko iano man'gopatna jotton ka'aha.
Unbaksa namnamgipa aro mingtogipa poedorang- koba donataha.
Ia kitapko badinge lapko man'na sejaha ; indiba Isol je bang'gija changa-sapaniko angna on'paaha, uko jattangni namgnina aro jattangko chuatanina jakkalpana miksongesa iako neng bee seaha.
Ia kitapko sena angko didigipa pilak angni ka'sara ripengrang, skigiparang aro gipinrangko anga mitela.
Angni neng'e kam kae amsokgija ong'engon aro iako matchotatna amjaengon angko ka'dimeatgipa aro didigipa angna Isolni on'gimin jikgipa Mrs.
Bethsida Ch.
Momin (Zeldama) koba anga mitelna gualja.
Achik jat silroroangchina aro Achik bi'sarang lekka porao silroro-namroroangchina angni sika aro bia.
Dated Tura, Lindrid D.
